This repository uses:

 - Playwright C#
 - .NET 10
 - Reqnroll
 - Azure DevOps Pipelines

Rules:

 - Use Playwright auto waiting.
 - Never use Thread.Sleep().
 - Prefer get by role.
 - Use Locator APIs.
 - Use assertions from Playwright.
 - Keep page objects thin.
 - Reuse existing framework methods.
